name: Corporate Action Instructed Balance Option Protect Instruction SD 4
definition: Provides additional information regarding corporate action instructed balance details at option protect level.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: Xpath to the element that is being extended.

OptionNumber.name: Option Number
OptionNumber.definition: Option number of the protect instruction.

ProtectIdentification.name: Protect Identification
ProtectIdentification.definition: Instruction reference number assigned by DTC to the uncovered protect instruction.

ProtectSafekeepingAccount.name: Protect Safekeeping Account
ProtectSafekeepingAccount.definition: For cover protect instructions whereby one safekeeping account is covering on behalf of another safekeeping account. The protect safekeeping account will be the account which submitted the original protect instruction.

ProtectIdentificationUncoveredQuantity.name: Protect Identification Uncovered Quantity
ProtectIdentificationUncoveredQuantity.definition: Quantity of the protect instruction which has not been covered.
